# Welcome!

This manual provides details on the available options, analysis routines and underlying algorithms used in Easy Electrophysiology. All file-loading and analysis code is [open source](https://github.com/easy-electrophysiology/easy-electrophysiology-analysis) and we are happy to answer questions on implementation and code.

We hope you will find our software a useful tool in your patch-clamp electrophysiology analysis. Please don't hesitate to contact us at [support@easyelectrophysiology.com](mailto:support@easyelectrophysiology.com) with any questions, suggestions or feedback.

Happy Analyzing!
